note: Thin by necessity: Radio Tehran only began in 1940 and few 1940s Persian recordings are reliably dated or on streaming. Delkash (radio from 1945), Marzieh and Banan were the radio voices, but individual 1940s titles could not be dated. Morgh-e Sahar (Qamar, 1927 recording) is an earlier evergreen. No foreign songs given: no reliable evidence of specific foreign hits in 1940s Iran.
